annotations.title: Re-sync a design system from its own origin

description: Re-read a design system's own origin — the stored tokens/pptx bytes it was imported from, or (for a Figma import) the live Figma file — and diff the fresh derivation against the system's current head version: roles added/removed/changed, type sets and scales added/removed, and the logo. A design system is usable by any kind of artifact, and so is this tool. Preview only by default, and never writes anything. Pass apply:true to write the diff as the next version and refresh the projected Style in place; a preview whose diff came back unchanged writes nothing even with apply:true. Requires an origin to re-sync from (import_design_system, or a Figma/pptx import, made one) and, for a Figma origin, a connected Figma account (see describe_capabilities → integrations).

apply.description: Write the next version instead of only previewing (default false)
